content:
Samira: Quick pulse on Quasar's preview - 25 seats provisioned, analytics shows 5 active. Rhea any blockers on invites or onboarding?

Rhea: Hi team. Most invites landed but admins report an 'insufficient permissions' error when creating workspaces. Security wants a short justification to allow project:create for preview role. Also two power users haven't received their activation emails.

Noah: @Rhea I can take workspace perms. Can you forward one example admin email that failed? I'll reproduce in a sandbox and propose the minimal role change.

Casey: I uploaded a lightweight 6-step quickstart for Quasar (invite flow, SSO, workspace create, API smoke, feedback): https://redwood.app/playbooks/quasar-quickstart

notify-bot: file upload: quasar-enable-recording.mp4 (28MB) to /shared/enablements/quasar at 2026-03-20T10:12Z

Rhea: Sending the failed email screenshot via DM now. Execs also asked for a simple success metric to decide whether to push to paid pilot after preview.

Samira: Drafting a compact success rubric: baseline = 12 active seats OR 300 API calls/day + workspace create + 3 quality prompts passing (relevance > 0.7). If not met by day 14, we'll mark renewal-risk and schedule a retention play. I'll also create a 2-question post-onboard survey (ease + value).

Noah: To speed up verification once perms are adjusted, here's the smoke curl I'll run during the session:

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEMP" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck","max_tokens":5}'
```

Casey: Proposed plan: 1) Noah/Quasar pair at 11:30am PT to validate permission change and resend activation emails, 2) Samira posts rubric + survey by EOD, 3) Quasar completes the 6-step quickstart and confirms seats, 4) 7-day telemetry review.

Rhea: 11:30 works. Appreciate the clear rubric — please send the survey link when ready.

Samira: Will do. Creating the invite and adding 'preview-watch' tag on the account so Sales sees the risk. Thanks everyone.
